<timestamp>Wednesday, Apr 29, 2026, 2:59 PM (UTC+3)</timestamp>
<user_query>
Check that the premium meter only fills when either cigarettes, alcohol or bloody hands are matched
</user_query>

I’ll trace where the premium meter fill logic is calculated, then verify whether it gates on matches of cigarettes, alcohol, or bloody hands only. I’ll report exactly what it currently does and flag any mismatch.
I found the meter-fill path and now I’m checking whether “premium” currently maps exactly to those three symbols, plus whether wild-containing lines could accidentally count.

Verified: the premium meter currently fills **only** from matches of the 3 premium symbols (cigarette, booze/alcohol, bloody hand).

- Meter gain is gated in `CombatRoot` by `_line_is_premium(line)` before calling `meter.add_from_line_length(...)`:

```801:809:AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd
func _apply_meter_from_lines(lines: Array) -> void:
	for line in lines:
		if _line_is_premium(line):
			meter.add_from_line_length(int(line["length"]))

func _line_is_premium(line: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var symbol_id: StringName = line.get("symbol_id", &"")
	return _premium_symbol_ids.has(symbol_id)
```

- `_premium_symbol_ids` is built from symbols whose tier is `PREMIUM`:

```112:116:AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd
elif sd.tier == SymbolDef.Tier.PREMIUM:
	premium_symbol_pool.append(sd)
	_weights[sd.id] = sd.base_weight
	_premium_symbol_ids[sd.id] = true
```

- In your active scene, the only premium symbols included are exactly those three (`sym_cigarette`, `sym_booze`, `sym_bloody_hand`), while wild is separate:

```9:17:AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn
[ext_resource type="Resource" path="res://combat/data/symbols/sym_satanic.tres" id="7_sym_wild"]
[ext_resource type="Resource" path="res://combat/data/symbols/sym_cigarette.tres" id="8_sym_cigarette"]
[ext_resource type="Resource" path="res://combat/data/symbols/sym_booze.tres" id="9_sym_booze"]
[ext_resource type="Resource" path="res://combat/data/symbols/sym_bloody_hand.tres" id="10_sym_bloody_hand"]
...
symbol_resources = [..., ExtResource("8_sym_cigarette"), ExtResource("9_sym_booze"), ExtResource("10_sym_bloody_hand"), ExtResource("7_sym_wild")]
```

So behavior matches your requirement.  
If you want, I can add a small regression test to lock this in.
